proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13291 *savēla gives Hindi sawerā morning and Ku./Nepali saber, explicitly explaining b through emphasis or ber. The suber-/saver- morning variants fit; nasal savā̃ra needs distinguishing *savāra. Reviewed comparison: H sabero “morning” (f_5fk76mavqwiws). Possible intra-IA borrowing remains open under the user’s policy; exact source forms are retained.
